prompt:
Analyze the following external review that has been addressed.
Identify what our INTERNAL code review should have caught
BEFORE the external reviewer found it.

## External Review Feedback


## Code Comments (with Resolutions)
- [operators/keystone/internal/metrics/cardinality_test.go:1] Move this test to `collectors_test.go`
- [operators/keystone/internal/metrics/collectors.go:109] If this constructor is test-only, move it to the test file `collectors_test.go`
- [operators/keystone/internal/metrics/collectors.go:236] If your internal methods are solely used in tests, move their definition to the test file `collectors_test.go`. 
- [operators/keystone/internal/metrics/contract_test.go:1] No, we are not going to unit test documentation against code. Remove `contract_test.go`
- [operators/keystone/internal/controller/instrumentation_test.go:433] We are *absolutely* not going to test source code via literal string analysis. This is not acceptable remove lines 262-432

## Resolution Summary
All five review comments were addressed by deleting and relocating test code. The cardinality test was merged into collectors_test.go (as TestSubReconcilerMetricsHaveNoCRLabels), the test-only newCollectorsForTest constructor was moved out of collectors.go into collectors_test.go, contract_test.go was deleted entirely, and the AST-based literal-analysis drift guard (plus its helpers and go/ast/parser/token imports) was removed from instrumentation_test.go. For comment [2], the internal methods on *collectors were kept in collectors.go because they are not test-only — each public package-level helper (ObserveReconcileDuration, RecordReconcileError, etc.) forwards to them — and the surrounding comment was rewritten to document this; the supporting code-comment in collectors.go was also updated to drop the stale reference to newCollectorsForTest.

Extract 0-3 review improvement patterns. For each:
- name: Short, action-oriented name IN ENGLISH
- review_area: error-handling | security | testing | performance | type-safety | validation | architecture | naming | documentation
- detection_hint: How should the reviewer detect this?
- severity: BLOCKING | WARNING
- what_to_check: What exactly to check
- why_it_matters: Why it matters
- example_feedback: Original quote from the reviewer
- example_fix: What was changed

QUALITY: Only real review blindspots. No subjective style opinions.
Nothing that only a domain expert could know.
If nothing extractable: empty array.

LANGUAGE: ALL fields MUST be in English.

Response: ONLY JSON array.
